selector.runner_up: Bullous lichen planus of the nails
selector.rationale: The presence of lichenoid plaques on the oral mucosa, violaceous discoloration of the nail folds, and histopathological findings such as basal cell degeneration and dense bandlike lymphohistiocytic infiltrate support the diagnosis of lichen planus.

rejected.label: Bullous lichen planus of the nails
rejected.why: While some features are consistent with bullous lichen planus, the overall clinical and histopathological picture is more consistent with lichen planus, and there is no strong evidence to support the bullous variant specifically.
